note: Solution-independent job statements. Each statement must pass the solution-neutral test: 5 different technologies or business models could plausibly address it.

jobs.statement: Verify that an installed energy retrofit delivered the contractually agreed performance outcome before releasing final payment.
contexts: Post-retrofit M&V period (typically 1–3 years after installation)
Annual performance review under Energy Performance Contract
triggers: Contractor submits performance claim for payment milestone
desiredOutcomes: Know with confidence whether the contractually defined energy savings target was met
Minimize time and cost required to resolve disputes about baseline or savings methodology
Have tamper-evident, auditable record of performance data accepted by both parties

evidence.summary: Derived from HeatProof idea-433 dossier in this repository. The idea explicitly targets the M&V verification problem in energy performance contracts.

jobs.statement: Demonstrate to a building owner that the installed retrofit measures delivered the contractually defined energy savings, using meter data adjusted for occupancy and weather.
contexts: Performance-based payment period under EPC or similar contract
desiredOutcomes: Produce a performance report both parties accept without additional negotiation
Minimize cost and delay of producing an accepted M&V report

evidence.summary: Derived from HeatProof idea-433 dossier. Contractor-side job is the mirror of the building owner verification job.

jobs.statement: Prove the actual megawatt-hour flexibility response delivered during a grid flexibility event matches what the aggregator will use for settlement payment.
triggers: Discrepancy discovered between SCADA log and operator data
desiredOutcomes: Know immediately after an event whether site SCADA data matches operator settlement data
Minimize manual effort to reconcile site meter data against grid operator timestamps
Prevent payment haircuts caused by data format or identifier mismatch, not under-performance

evidence.summary: Derived from FlexCovenant idea-434 dossier. The idea targets settlement data reconciliation between industrial sites and flexibility aggregators.

jobs.statement: Distribute performance-based payments accurately across enrolled flexibility participants after reconciling each site's delivered response against grid operator settlement data.
desiredOutcomes: Issue accurate settlement payments within contracted timeframe

evidence.summary: Derived from FlexCovenant idea-434 dossier. Aggregator-side settlement job.

jobs.statement: Independently verify that a vendor's product or service performs as claimed before committing to a purchase or contract.
triggers: Vendor makes a performance or certification claim
desiredOutcomes: Have independent evidence of vendor product performance specific to buyer's configuration
Minimize time and cost of producing comparable vendor evidence
Reduce post-contract discovery of gaps between claimed and actual performance

evidence.summary: Derived from FactBounty idea-061 dossier. The idea targets the buyer's job of independently verifying vendor claims.
